summary: Ground lookout in the Lolo National Forest with an L-4 cab dated 1933 and destroyed in 1962. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1962. No source describes what remains on the site.

events.note: firelookout.com lists an L-4 cab under 1933

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one history page (firelookout.com) gives the 1933 and 1962 dates; the FFLA list gives the status. The 1933 date is read as the build year because the page lists the L-4 cab under that year. The Sanders County Ledger article was read in full (it ends after the Eddy Peak entry and a sidebar line): it describes the L-4 design generally and has no Snowstorm entry. The 'by far the most popular' and 'windows all around' lines are design descriptions, not claims about this site, and the story no longer says 'in the county'. Record elevation_m is null; 6,992 ft is about 2,131 m by conversion, not added to the record. No access, staffing, fire or current-site source found. Record status (gone) and kind (ground) agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
